newsitem.title: USA: Rupert Murdoch -- wealthiest in southern California.
newsitem.headline: Rupert Murdoch -- wealthiest in southern California.

text.p: Media magnate Rupert Murdoch, who lives in Beverly Hills for two-thirds of the year, is worth an estimated $3.2 billion, making him the richest person in southern California, a business publication reported Monday.
The Australian-born Murdoch edged out real estate baron Marvin Davis, whose net value was estimated by the Los Angeles Business Journal at $2.9 billion.

News Corp. Ltd. Chairman Murdoch, who is poised to buy one of America's most famous sports teams, the Los Angeles Dodgers baseball team, qualified for the Journal's list of the wealthiest people in the region because he now spends some eight months a year at his Beverly Hills home.
Third on the list is the Chandler family, which owns the Times Mirror Co. and is worth an estimated $2.1 billion.
Entertainment magnate David Geffen is fourth with $2 billion and his Dreamworks SKG partner, movie director Steven Spielberg is sixth, at $1.1 billion.
The top eight on the list are billionaires.
The Journal said there are nearly 4,000 residents of Los Angeles County with adjusted gross annual income of at least $1 million.
"What this tells us is that many enterprising people find southern California an ideal location to launch or expand a business.
"We find example after example of success stories originating here. That says something about the nurturing economic infrastructure of Los Angeles," the Business Journal said.
Other famous names on the wealthiest southern Californians list are:
-- Roy Disney, vice chairman of the Walt Disney Co., and nephew of the famous animator, is 12th at $740 million, mostly in Disney stock and investments.
-- Junk bond king Michael Milken is 18th with an estimated worth of $600 million.
-- Disney Chairman and CEO Michael Eisner is 38th with $405 million.
-- Jeffrey Katzenberg, Geffen and Spielberg's partner, 39th with $400 million.
-- "Melrose Place" TV producer Aaron Spelling, 45th with $350 million.
-- Former movie cowboy and broadcaster Gene Autry, 46th with $320 million.
-- Former TV talk show host Merv Griffin, 50th with $300 million.
